entities.summary: Jose Lazaro Fuerte Advincula Jr. is a Filipino friar of the Dominican Order and a prelate of the Catholic Church who has been the 33rd and present metropolitan archbishop of Manila since 2021. He previously served as the bishop of San Carlos from 2001 to 2011, and metropolitan archbishop of Capiz from 2011 to 2021. On December 16, 2020, Pope Francis appointed Advincula as a member of the Dicastery for Clergy, and made him a cardinal in November 2020.
